tooling.message:
fix(check): judge the commit's arc42 diff instead of failing on every hint

## Intent

A fresh interactive app's first commit after the plan ran `arc42 diff --staged --strict`, which fails on every hint. arc42 diff does not read .arc42ignore, so src/main.ts and src/env.d.ts counted as not covered, and it hints "review architecture element" at every file under an interface's path. The agent then accepted with ARC42_CONSISTENT and went on to set it in advance, which bypasses the gate. The gate should block only what is really wrong.

## Key changes

- lernapps check runs `arc42 diff --staged --format json` and judges the findings itself.
- Consistency findings and new code that no block claims fail; .arc42ignore applies as validate applies it.
- Review hints are a warning in the report.
- ARC42_CONSISTENT accepts only consistency findings, which stay in the report as a warning; it never accepts new code.
- The skills say that setting it without a finding shown is a bypass like --no-verify.

## Dependencies and side effects

- A new e2e test replays the case from the first creator run.
